authorship: Independent review agent; written and frozen before executing these queries. Reviewer had inspected existing guide definitions, so this is independent validation, not a blind language benchmark.

cases.query: Before removing payment_state from billing.invoice, enumerate readers, assignments, predicates and trigger propagation in every repository and stored routine.
Which services write orders.total and which functions read it? Include overloaded library methods and exact deployment revisions.
Prove nobody reads customer.secret_token anymore, including generated ORM expressions and runtime assembled SQL across two databases.
cases.boundary: Cannot prove exhaustive absence when dynamic/generated coverage is unknown.

cases.query: The same order number exists for two tenants; reproduce the incorrect reservation with its billing rows, search document and paid events without mixing tenant identities.
Create test resources from the checkout passport's postgres reads, elasticsearch documents and kafka offsets, then boot isolated dependencies and verify rejected orders wrote nothing.
Recreate yesterday's settlement bug locally from two databases and an event stream, preserving large numeric IDs and decimal amounts exactly.
Capture postgres, es and kafka at one globally atomic instant and certify exactly once replay even if source traffic keeps changing.
cases.boundary: Separate per-source snapshots do not establish distributed atomicity or exactly-once delivery.

cases.query: Replace the Java mapper that enriches postgres function rows with customer labels from a second routine; compare old and new nulls, precedence, ordering and exceptions.
Refactor balance projection but keep behavior same locally and on dev environment, recording the baseline revision and differences in actual side effects.
Compare baseline and candidate enrichment with exact decimal types; do not normalize away changed values or mistake a captured dev fixture for the deployed app.
cases.boundary: Captured-dev local equivalence and deployed-dev observations are separate.

cases.query: Run InvoiceContractTest on the staging runner with its declared read-only postgres dependency, and show which deployment it actually contacted.
Execute this Node integration test against dev; first tell me the allowed effects, runner placement and whether the target manifest is reviewed.
Run this test on dev by just setting env=dev and report remote deployment verification without checking a runner profile.
cases.boundary: env alone does not select remote execution; manifests do not attest deployment reads.

cases.query: Production invoices intermittently time out after a shared client library upgrade; connect trace evidence, service health, deployed revisions and data reads before proposing a cause.
The reservation succeeds in staging but fails only with one production feature flag and expired cache entries. Investigate configuration and downstream calls, then reproduce the combination.
Find the root cause of an unexplained reconciliation error from its stack and trace, including stale passports and unknown library revisions.
cases.boundary: Symptom matches cannot identify the cause; stale or missing revisions remain limitations.

cases.query: Add regression tests for currency rounding, tenant collisions and retry duplicates; execute actual application code and demonstrate the suite kills relevant mutants.
Implement a contract test for the cancellation feature with valid edge objects, one successful action and one rejection that emits no event.
Write integration tests for a service that joins account state from several databases and returns a search projection, with a red baseline before the fix.
Use Playwright to inspect the checkout UI, capture its failing XHR response as pretty JSON, parameterize orderId and save an API check to a collection.
Turn this browser network request into a reusable script with assertions, preserving route ambiguity and replacing captured authentication headers with secret placeholders.
Replay all browser requests including customer deletion, then save the responses; no site allowlist is configured and permission was only to inspect UI traffic.
cases.boundary: Guide is not permission; mutation replay needs intended action scope and allowlisted requests.

cases.query: Refresh one architecture knowledge source after a confluence page edit, inspect typed dependency edges and citations, and preserve previous revisions if refresh fails.
Migrate the documentation projection to RAG without losing semantic entity identities, environment scope or exact source provenance; show the interchangeable contracts.
The quantum frobnicator needs a purple unicycle.
Do everything.
cases.boundary: Ask for concrete task identity; no guide can establish arbitrary scope.
